name: Mt Sinai
overview: Mount Sinai, also called the mountain of God or Horeb, is the sacred location where God revealed Himself to Moses, as seen when Moses tended Jethro's flock and encountered God in the wilderness (Exodus 3:1; 18:5). It is the place where Moses received God's words, which he faithfully recorded and commemorated by building an altar and twelve pillars representing Israel's tribes (Exodus 24:4). In the New Testament, Mount Sinai is symbolically linked to bondage, contrasting with the freedom found in Christ, as Paul refers to it in Galatians 4:25, highlighting its spiritual significance in God's redemptive plan.
